nodes.long_description:
TOTALLY BASEBALL: After having the most popular VR Baseball game since 2021 there was only one thing left to do. MAKE IT EVEN BETTER! Updated Avatars and Graphics for newer Quest headsets! Improved Multiplayer gameplay and lots of new customizer items! Enjoy playing in our small fields or huge stadiums!  From 1v1 all the way up to 20 people in FREE PLAY mode!
"One of the best sports games on Oculus Quest." - ScreenRant
"Totally Baseball is the complete baseball experience in virtual reality, and there's no other game that compares to it." - GameRant
"Is it good? Heck yes, it's good!" - BMFVR
Features:
-REALISTIC throwing and batting physics
-MULTIPLE GAME MODES (1v1 or Free Roam with up to 20+ people at once!)
-SPECIAL PITCHES! Add curve balls, slowballs, splitters to your options
-PRO BATTING MODE, after you master "classic" batting try the new "PRO" option for more of a challenge!
-Practice and tutorial modes for new players to find their pitching/batting sweet spot!
-Multiple teams/venues to choose from (and play against)
-Comfort settings and hand position settings that can be fine-tuned to your liking
-Fun seasonal updates (Check out new fields and new items throughout the year)
-Large community of people to play with or get tips from (See our Discord)
nodes.short_description: Play the full sport of Baseball (every position) on your own or in Multiplayer with friends!

nodes.long_description:
TOTALLY BASEBALL is the only VR Baseball Game that lets you play the full sport of Baseball! Throw a strike but if the batter hits it to the outfield...BOOM! Now you're an outfielder and now have to run over and catch it!  You'll be amazed at how realistic our throwing feels! Start with easy mode and throwing assist set to high, get better over time and play with less assistance for more of a challenge!  

-Multiple throwing options
-Multiple venues to choose
-Multiple locomotion methods
-Customizable comfort settings
-Customizable characters
-Practice and Tutorial modes
-Multiplayer COMING SOON!

Have trouble with throwing/aiming but still want to play the game?  Don't worry we made a hand cannon option just for you!
nodes.short_description: Run the bases, throw a strike, catch a pop fly and even make a double play!  TOTALLY BASEBALL is the only VR Baseball game that lets you play the full sport of Baseball!

nodes.change_log:
Patch Notes (Live v2.5878):
Bug Fixes:
Resolved an issue causing the Zevo Games introductory splash screen to cut itself short on the SteamVR and Viveport versions of the game.
Clicking the join button on a game within the lobby browser no longer results in an infinite hung loading screen when the join process silently fails. Instead, the player now correctly gets returned to the lobby browser.
The current play now properly resets when dropping the ball at the AI pitcher’s feet in 1v1
Human catchers can no longer yank the ball away from the human batter in 1v1, robbing the batter from batting the ball
Fixed AI runners in 1v1 running bases when the ball is dropped in the outfield after a walk or an overthrow
Fixed the game treating walks as in play balls when the human batter is beaned but hits the ball with the bat at the same time
Fixed the AI catcher getting sometimes stuck on walk events and not throwing the ball back to the pitcher
Fixed AI runners running 2 bases on an overthrow if the ball is dropped in the outfield right before they reach base
Fixed AI runners sometimes stealing home from third base on a foul ball
Fixed players sometimes not being able to grab the skip lever
Fixed players sometimes not being able to manually grab the ball
Fixed the player slowly sinking into the ground over time
Fixed an issue preventing players from creating another multiplayer game after going into a multiplayer game and backing out to the lobby together
Applied a general fix for the AI catcher sometimes getting stuck in multiplayer 1v1
Fixed an issue causing paid players to see the cannon, special pitches, and batflips purchase prompts
Fixed an issue causing the joined player in multiplayer 1v1 to either end up on a black screen or see their TV menu turn off when the host appears in the locker room for them if they got to the locker room before the host did
Fixed the 1v1 and free roam menu titles showing up at the same time when a created lobby is still loading
Fixed players being taggable on a homerun in multiplayer 1v1 if the ball bounces off the fence before leaving the field
Improvements:
Adjusted the shader on the local player’s hands to match the skin shader used on all other bodies in the game
Made AI players in multiplayer 1v1 attempt to pick up the ball again after fumbling instead of just standing there
Made the AI catcher in multiplayer 1v1 wait until the foul popup finishes playing to throw the ball back to the pitcher

Patch Notes (Live v2.5876):
Bug Fixes:
Resolved an engine security vulnerability.
Resolved an issue that would sometimes cause AI batters to spawn with a human batter in 1v1.
Greatly improved runner list synchronization in 1v1.
Resolved an issue that would sometimes cause multiplayer 1v1 to get stuck after batting a homerun.
Increased ball position accuracy across clients in Multiplayer.
The ball no longer floats in the air when a player leaves free roam with the ball in their hand.
The hand calibration menu now correctly displays the saved yaw and roll values when opened.
Fixed multiple issues that would cause the catcher to get stuck with the ball in 1v1.
Resolved an issue that caused one client to be missing runners when returned to home plate.
Leaving a Free Roam while batting no longer prevents other players from gaining a bat in the batter zone.
The remote bat angle no longer snaps to an incorrect angle when resetting as a batter in 1v1.
Closing the calibration menu in multiplayer now properly reflects the calibrated angle to other players.
Backing out of the host options menu restarts the check for hosted games on the lobby browser.
Joining a 1v1 match between innings no longer makes both players set to the same side.
Fixed a flaw in the microphone reset button in multiplayer.
Resolved several internal errors, vastly improving game stability.
The ball no longer stops moving and falls out of the air if a player throws it then leaves a multiplayer match.
The shadow now shows on the ground when set to sitting mode.
The game now more accurately determines when the pitcher is on the pitcher’s mound with ball in hand in 1v1.
Corrected some base ring logic in 1v1.
AI runners in 1v1 now stand closer to the center for popflies.
Fixed an issue that prevented the ball from returning to the field if thrown out of the park in Free Roam.
Backing out of a multiplayer lobby with smooth locomotion no longer locks the player in place.
Resolved some errors that prevented players from completing their walk during a walk or overthrow.
Fixed an issue causing runners to be forced forward when no runner is directly behind them in 1v1.
Human batter-runners that stand on home plate when an AI gets the ball at first base are now properly forced out when they leave home plate in 1v1.
Corrected some AI running logic on foul balls in 1v1.
Fixed an issue with AI runners not properly being outed when forced forward in 1v1.
When the host leaves a multiplayer match, the new host now has the option to return everybody to the locker room lobby.
Fixed another case of the ball being stuck in the air when a player leaves a free roam match with the ball in their hand.
Improvements:
The bat in the intro menu no longer swaps skins and now maintains a good contrast with the menu background.
A description of the two batting modes has been added to the intro batting menu.

Patch Notes (Live v2.5874):
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue causing the menu to be missing when returning to the locker room in Free Roam.
- Resolved an issue preventing players from changing venues if they host a game after backing out of a multiplayer game as a joined player.
- The player can no longer use trickery to equip unowned jerseys.
- Fixed an issue causing players to sometimes appear as wearing the wrong jersey when loading into Free Roam.
- Left handed remote players should no longer be missing a hand when joining a Free Roam game that is already on the field.
- Fixed an issue causing an infinite loading screen when joining a game fails.
- The loading screen no longer displays on top of the lobby browser when joining a multiplayer game.
- Resolved an issue causing AI runners to spawn on a base with a bat in 1v1 if a player joins midgame.
- Becoming the next batter while standing on 3rd base no longer scores in solo 1v1.
- The ball correctly returns to the field when throwing an overthrow in 1v1.
- Corrected an issue causing a desync in the scoreboard when joining mid-game in 1v1.
- The player is now returned to the locker room in 1v1 if they are a spectator when the other player leaves the game.
- Corrected a guardian orientation issue when manually choosing a position.
- The ball no longer maintains its velocity and rolls away from the player when a high velocity ball is caught by the AI pitcher and the player repossesses them in 1v1.
- The player is no longer able to get more than 3 outs in an inning and cause a desync in 1v1.
- Manually teleporting into the pitcher no longer causes the AI runners to steal a base in 1v1.
- Players now see leading off runners in their correct positions when joining a 1v1 match that is already on the field.
- Dropping the ball on the mound no longer counts as a pitch attempt in 1v1.
- The Quest Roster now properly updates when players join a match while on the field in multiplayer.
- The player no longer resets and sees the screen fade when playing a fielding position and remain within their at pitch zone in single player.
- Fixed an issue causing Quick Menu buttons to be difficult to click in the Koshien booth.
- Resolved another infinite loading screen issue when hosting a game in multiplayer.
- There is no longer a gap in the single player opponent selection menu if you don’t own the Bats team.
- Getting hit by a pitch in the batting tutorial no longer allows you to run around.
- Fixed an issue causing the pitcher to get stuck if they caught a batted ball when there are no additional runners in 1v1.
- Joining a 1v1 match that is already on the field now properly syncs the innings and frames.
- Fixed an issue causing the catcher in a solo 1v1 match to throw to first base when a runner is stealing toward second base.
- Resolved several stuck states caused by joining a 1v1 match during specific events.
- The player’s jerseys are now the correct team if the host leaves a 1v1 match and a new player joins in their stead.
- Fixed an issue causing players to have batting gloves in the booth in 1v1.
- The player is no longer ignored as a passing target for base defense when playing solo 1v1.
- Resolved some issues causing seemingly random extra outs to occur in 1v1.
- The catcher now properly returns the ball to the pitcher instead of throwing it to random fielders in 1v1.
- AI fielders will now put their hands down when somebody else catches a ball they were planning to catch in 1v1.
- Players now see the correct bat skin on other players when joining midgame in multiplayer.
- Corrected some base stealing logic in 1v1.
- Fixed an issue causing the AI to become confused about who is who when a player joins a 1v1 match after the host has changed positions.
- Runners now correctly spawn on base if a walk is given immediately following a caught out with batter runner on base in 1v1.
- Base rings now properly disappear when a runner is outed while touching a base in 1v1.
- Fixed some issues causing additional AI batters to spawn when a player is batting in 1v1.
- The player’s mitt no longer shows in the pitcher’s mound when joining a 1v1 match that is already on the field.
- Spectators will no longer see the batter with a mitt when they join a 1v1 match while the host is batting.
- The bat now plays the correct sound effect, graphics, and vibration when holding it very still for a bunt in 1v1.
- Joining a 1v1 match mid-game no longer interferes with the host’s game events.
- Corrected an issue causing the bat angle to change remotely in multiplayer when refreshing a batter.
Improvements:
- Improved roster synchronization on Quest version.
- The skip lever now disappears until the joining player is fully loaded when they join a 1v1 match during a booth sequence.
- Joining players are no longer able to return everybody to the locker room in Free Roam.
- Improved the synchronization process when going to the booth after a player has joined midgame in 1v1.
